verdict: Organic activity is carrying the account; paid ads remain off.
narrative: This period, all activity came through organic channels — paid ads on Meta and Google are not running, so there are no paid leads or spend to report. Your Google Business Profile was the standout, generating 29 actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) over 28 days, with a spike in late August that has since settled. Search clicks and website sessions both pulled back about 41% week-over-week, which is worth watching as it may reflect the August spike normalizing. Ad creative and targeting are being prepared so paid channels can be reactivated and begin generating measurable leads again.
